dict.string: With Phone tools turned on, Redde sets an alarm or a timer when your assistant asks it to, once you have said yes to it.

Redde can show your next event when you start a conversation, and attach a day's events to a message for your assistant. With Phone tools turned on, your assistant can also look up events and add them. Events go only to your own server.
Redde uses the camera when you take a photo to attach to a message, when you show your assistant something in voice mode, and to scan a setup code. A photo goes only to the server you connect to.
With Phone tools turned on, Redde looks up a contact when your assistant asks it to. What it finds goes only to the server you connect to.
Redde uses Face ID to unlock the app, which holds your Hermes credentials.

With Health-Aware Days turned on, Redde reads last night's sleep, your steps and your workouts so your agent's morning ideas and evening wrap-up take your day into account. Only a one-line summary goes to your own server.
Redde connects to the Hermes gateway or model server you configure, which is often on your local network.

With Places turned on, Redde notices when you arrive at or leave a place you set, even when Redde is closed, and tells the bot you chose. Where you are stays on your iPhone; only "arrived at Home" goes to your server.

With Places on, Redde uses where you are to set a place and to notice when you arrive or leave; only "arrived at Home" goes to your server. With Current Location on, your own agent hears roughly where you are when you ask about places, directions or the weather.

Redde listens so you can talk to your assistant. Speech is transcribed on this device and only your own server receives the text, unless you start a live voice call, which goes to the voice service you chose.
Redde reads head movement from your AirPods so you can nod to approve, or shake your head to deny, a request from your assistant. It is read on this device and never stored or sent.
With Phone tools turned on, Redde finds photos, shows one to your assistant, or deletes the ones you confirm, when your assistant asks it to. A photo goes only to the server you connect to.
With Phone tools turned on, Redde reads and adds reminders when your assistant asks it to. They go only to the server you connect to.
